verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke documents a dedicated EC/VC practice whose stated focus runs from seed and Series A rounds onward, covering term sheets, valuation mechanics and investment structures. It also publishes founder resources: an investor-readiness tool and free UK and DE cap table templates. However, nothing in the evidence specifically mentions SAFEs, convertible notes, ASAs or other convertible instruments, or pre-seed work. Missing for 10: explicit SAFE/convertible instrument experience, pre-seed round coverage, published SAFE/convertible explainers or forms, independent corroboration.
